jobs.description:
Maxonic maintains a close and long-term relationship with our direct client. In support of their needs, we are looking for a Program Manager High-volume Manufacturing (HVM) in Electronics 
 
Job Description:
 
Job Title: Program Manager High-volume Manufacturing (HVM) in Electronics 
Job Type: Fulltime
Job Location: Cupertino, CA
Work Schedule: Onsite 
Salary: 150k to 160k, Based on experience
 
The Project Manager will manage the relationship with Contract Manufacturers and oversee projects from customer commitment to implementation.
 
Responsibilities:

Manage projects from customer commitment to implementation, ensuring on-time, on-budget delivery.
Define project scope, timelines, and resource needs, and develop project specifications.
Provide regular status updates to senior management and team members.
Maintain project tracking documentation and support the development of BOMs for new items.
Coordinate with R&D, Operations, and Engineering teams to manage product formulas, production capability, and testing.
Manage change part communications and coordinate trial schedules with Quality and Production teams.
	.

Qualifications:

5-10 +years of project management experience.
Strong communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Worked with Technology CMs like – Foxconn, Pegatron, Wistron, Compal, Quanta, Tata, Inventa, Flextronics or Flex, Jabil, Luxshare, BYD Electronics 
Worked with large global companies and drove the relationship with the CM. Large global companies include – Apple, Microsoft, Sony, Dell, HP, Meta, ASUS, Acer, Cisco, Huawei etc…
Must be able to work under pressure
Must be able to travel to China
Able to speak Mandarin a big plus

jobs.title: IT Asset Associate
jobs.location: 100 Washington Ave S, Suite 900, Minneapolis, MN 55401
jobs.description:
Maxonic maintains a close and long-term relationship with our direct client. In support of their needs, we are looking for an IT Asset Associate
 
Job Title: IT Asset Associate
Job Type: Contract                                       
Job Location: Minneapolis, MN
Work Schedule: On-site
Pay Rate: $30-40 on W2 / $30-48 on c2c, Based on experience
 
Description:
The IT Asset Associate is responsible for supporting the end-to-end lifecycle of hardware assets, ensuring every employee receives the right device at the right time.
This role owns stockroom operations — from receiving and registering new equipment to executing device refreshes, processing buybacks, and coordinating logistics for remote US employees. The IT Asset Associate maintains accurate asset records in the CMDB and resolves hardware-related ServiceNow requests in partnership with the IT Asset Management team.

Responsibilities


Manage MSP office stockroom inventory, maintaining accurate records of all hardware assets, accessories, and loaner/test devices in the CMDB
Execute device refresh cycles for MSP on-site and remote US employees, coordinating device preparation, shipping logistics, and asset returns from start to finish
Receive, scan, and register incoming Apple hardware and accessories into the CMDB upon delivery, ensuring accurate asset records from point of intake
Issue new, loaner, and test devices to employees following established check-out procedures and documenting all transactions in ServiceNow
Collect and process returned devices from departing or refreshed employees, ensuring proper data wiping, chain-of-custody documentation, and CMDB updates
Process device buyback requests in accordance with Client's policy, managing transactions and updating asset records accordingly
Facilitate data transfers for employees receiving new devices, following established migration procedures and coordinating directly with end users
Coordinate inbound shipments from Apple and technology vendors and manage outbound device shipments to remote US employees, ensuring accurate tracking and timely delivery
Resolve ServiceNow tickets related to hardware requests, device issues, and asset management inquiries within established SLA timeframes; escalate non-standard requests and policy exceptions to the IT Asset Management team
Conduct monthly stockroom audits to reconcile physical inventory against CMDB records, reporting discrepancies to management
Maintain the organization and security of the MSP stockroom, ensuring all assets are properly labeled, stored, and accessible
Other duties and special projects as assigned


Qualifications:


Required

0–2 years of experience in IT asset management, stockroom/inventory operations, or
		a related field
Familiarity with IT hardware, including laptops, peripherals, and accessories
Experience working with an ITSM ticketing system such as ServiceNow
Strong organizational skills with high attention to detail
Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs
High school diploma or equivalent


Preferred

Experience handling Apple hardware and macOS devices
Familiarity with CMDB or IT asset management systems
Experience with MDM platforms 
Prior experience in a corporate IT environment
Associate’s degree or vocational certificate in IT, Computer Science, or a related
		field


A combination of relevant experience and education may be considered

SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory.
Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches.
Acknowledging the company Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles.

 
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Onsite work required
Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs
Ability to stand, walk, and perform repetitive physical tasks associated with stockroom operations
